permissions: Each new evidence file is CREATE_NEW with POSIX0600 at creation. No raw user/model/browser/context/request IDs or credentials in new budget/response/privacy exports.

files.guard-tally.json: Exact byte copy of the original real canonical build/guard-tally/GuidedPublicationReplayIT.json. No reconstruction; byte equality checked.
files.cohort.json: Closed lane/profile, declared ceiling, actual run/cohort UUID, actual validated method/display label/variant/ordinal, passed/afterEachComplete, final audit/privacy/producer/model/budget/response status.
files.audit-final.json: Final complete scanner result after real stop/context destruction, before detach. Actual emitted event/canary counts and real drain/context status.
files.model-budget-evidence-{closed invocation: Numeric/boolean only, unique immutable lane/method/closed variant+invocation ordinal path; actual session/attempt ordinals, committed service reservation/persisted/gateway/HTTP witnesses, input bytes, totals/proposal/no-refund checks. Partial complete=false persisted on assertion failure.
files.responses-{closed invocation key}-{after: Closed identity plus every sent call/failure, numeric/hash actual UTF8 text/envelope bytes, exact private SQL attempt join, programmed20/40, actual wire ceiling, min(actual transport byte bound,65536), actual APPLIED disposition and per-kind applied maxima. After-each is a partial snapshot; final follows producer drain.
files.privacy-{closed invocation key}.json: Unique closed identity and actual session ordinals; explicit whole-cohort sink inventory with closed sink kind+name hash+byte count+content hash; never35 independent scan claims.

closedInvocationKey: {lane}-{actual invocation ordinal}-{closed method}-{singleton|one of unchanged35 labels}
guardFailureSafety: JOIN final lifecycle always attempts real tally and cohort in finally; each Test task has a guaranteed ordered finalizer checking actual JOIN case events/fresh unique cohort and exact current canonical copy before next lane; no export after JVM crash is fabricated.
fullGate: requireFreshGuidedPartitions requires fresh nonempty per-task exec,43+37 exact identities/test event counts, all invocation passed/completed and real final audit/privacy/drain/model/budget/response completion. check/report/verification depend both; all thresholds and crossReplica scope unchanged.
